finalText:
All objectives are complete and verified. Here is my final report:

**Objective 1 — DONE:** Board columns of project `Bench Board`, left-to-right as shown: **Backlog, Ready, Work in progress, Done**

**Objective 2 — DONE:** Task `fwkb27-n1 Bench Task` exists on the Bench Board project, with description **"Bench task for run fwkb27-n1"** (includes the runid `fwkb27-n1`).

**Objective 3 — DONE:** The task was moved (dragged on the board) and now sits in the **Work in progress** column. Verified after a full page reload: the Work in progress column contains exactly one card, `fwkb27-n1 Bench Task`; the three `Seed:` tasks (#1, #2, #3) remain untouched in Backlog.

**Objective 4 — DONE:** The task has one comment with text **"Comment for run fwkb27-n1"** (author «redacted»), which includes the runid.

**Objective 5 — DONE:** The task's due date is set to **2026-12-31**. The app renders it as "Due date: 12/31/2026 19:11" (this instance's m/d/Y H:i display format — the date component is 2026-12-31; the app normalizes the field to a datetime and appends a time).

**Objective 6 — DONE:** The task's numeric ID as displayed by the app is **#4** (task page heading reads "Task #4").

Notes: The task page's "Move to project" action was unusable ("There is no destination project available"), so the move was accomplished by dragging the card on the board. No seed tasks were modified or moved.
